responsibility: Implements a lightweight SSA copy-propagation pass based on strongly connected components of the SSA dataflow graph. It collects simple assignment copies and degenerate or mutually redundant PHIs, runs Tarjan SCC discovery over the relevant statements, identifies SCCs whose members refer only to each other and a single outside value, replaces all uses of the SCC-defined names with that value, and then triggers DCE, dead EH-edge cleanup, and SSA/CFG updates to remove the now-redundant copy statements.
